sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, shutil, csv

src='/app/documents'
inv_dir='/app/invoices'
oth_dir='/app/other'
os.makedirs(inv_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(oth_dir, exist_ok=True)

# classification: filename -> (is_invoice, total_amount, vat_amount)
invoices = {
 '2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg': (4382.00, None, 6558.00),  # Total used over Amount due
 'JOiylq2_7S18.jpg': (None, 623.68, 6860.45),
 'KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg': (None, None, 9963.00),    # Total used over Amount due
 'T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf': (None, None, 4031.00),
 'UsN9tVTKskms.pdf': (None, None, 896.00),
 'ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg': (None, 74.46, 819.06),
 'lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg': (None, 72.54, 797.91),
 'vvK89XK847m3.jpg': (None, 564.02, 6204.19),
 'w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg': (None, 4067.78, 44745.59),
 'wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf': (None, None, 440.00),
}
# tuple is (amount_due, vat, total). total is always used (per special case).
rows=[]
for name in sorted(os.listdir(src)):
    p=os.path.join(src,name)
    if not os.path.isfile(p): continue
    if name in invoices:
        _, vat, total = invoices[name]
        rows.append((name, f"{total:.2f}", f"{(vat or 0):.2f}"))
        shutil.move(p, os.path.join(inv_dir,name))
    else:
        shutil.move(p, os.path.join(oth_dir,name))

sum_total=sum(float(r[1]) for r in rows)
sum_vat=sum(float(r[2]) for r in rows)
rows.append(('total', f"{sum_total:.2f}", f"{sum_vat:.2f}"))

with open(os.path.join(inv_dir,'summary.csv'),'w',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f)
    w.writerow(['filename','total_amount','vat_amount'])
    w.writerows(rows)
print(open(os.path.join(inv_dir,'summary.csv')).read())
print('documents left:', os.listdir(src))
print('invoices:', sorted(os.listdir(inv_dir)))
print('other:', sorted(os.listdir(oth_dir)))
PY
EOF
